rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: In a statement dated 9 May 1996, President Mandela says that 'Deputy-President FW de Klerk' informed him earlier that day that the National Party had decided to withdraw from the Government of National Unity.

locator.section: Statement heading and dateline (9 May 1996); first paragraph

rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: In the same statement Mandela thanks 'Deputy President FW de Klerk and his colleagues' for the constructive role that they have played, and says he is confident that 'we shall continue to work together in pursuit of the country's Interests'.

locator.section: Ninth paragraph, beginning 'I wish to thank Deputy President FW de Klerk'
